summary: THE TRUE VINE product page fully tested end-to-end. Backend: all 16 SKU combos validate at expected CAD prices; tampered $4,000 on signature__rope-22 correctly rejected with server_price=4950. Frontend: page renders, configurator updates prices for all 4 tested combos (default heirloom+rope-22=$6,150 CAD, foundation+pendant-only=$2,200, signature+rope-20=$4,850, collector+rope-24=$8,300), Add-To-Cart fires toast + opens cart drawer with correct item. Catalog /shop shows 'THE TRUE VINE' card with 'From $1,650 USD' and link routes to /the-true-vine. One observation: cart drawer line shows '$6,150 USD' label for what was a CAD price — no currency conversion appears to be applied (raw CAD number rendered with USD suffix). May be acceptable per existing site convention but flagging.

integration_issues.issue: Cart drawer renders the CAD price (6150) with 'USD' suffix ('$6,150 USD'). Either conversion to USD is missing or the suffix is wrong. Product page showed '$6,150 CAD'. Verify against PHILEON-wide cart currency strategy.
